quest_text: Step outside and walk to the nearest corner. At each intersection, flip a coin to choose left or right. After 10 minutes, find your way back without a map.
Find the highest point you can reach within 10 minutes on foot - a hill, a bridge or a stairway - and spend two minutes taking in the view before heading back.
Go outside and find five different kinds of leaves within a block of your door. Photograph them side by side on the ground, then identify one with a free plant app.
Stand still outside for 5 minutes and count every bird you see or hear. Then try to spot one of them up close.
Take a sketchbook or your phone outside and draw the first interesting thing you see in under 10 minutes - no erasing allowed.
Walk around the block and find three examples of street art, murals or interesting signs. Pick a favourite and work out who made it or why it's there.
Go outside, close your eyes for 2 minutes and notice every sound. Walk somewhere new and repeat, then write down which spot sounded more like a song.
Make a 3-song playlist that matches the weather right now, then go for a walk that lasts exactly as long as the playlist.
Grab a snack, find a bench or patch of grass outside you've never sat on, and eat it slowly while people-watching.
Walk to the nearest street-food stand, bakery window or market stall and try one thing under five dollars that you've never had before. Eat it outside.
Find the oldest-looking building, plaque or monument within a 10-minute walk and photograph a detail that shows its age.
Look up the story behind your street's name, then walk its full length looking for clues to that history.
Head outside and do a 10-minute interval walk: one minute brisk, one minute easy, five times. Finish by stretching against a tree or railing.
Find an outdoor staircase or slope nearby and climb it five times. Time the last climb and try to beat it next week.
Go outside and photograph something of every colour of the rainbow within 15 minutes.
Find a puddle, window or still water nearby and take three reflection photos that make the world look upside down.
Play real-life bingo on a short walk: spot a red door, a dog, a bike, a bird, a flag and something shaped like a heart.
Open a geocaching app, pick the nearest cache within 1 km and try to find it in under 25 minutes.
Pick one tree near your home, identify its species and find three facts about it, then go and check it for each feature.
Use a star or sky app outside to identify one planet, constellation or cloud type you can see right now.
Say hello to a neighbour or someone walking a dog and ask one question about the area you didn't know.
Text a friend to meet you outside for a 15-minute walk-and-talk around the block - no phones out once you're walking.
Take a bag outside and pick up 10 pieces of litter on your street or the nearest park path.
Find a little free library, community board or donation box nearby and leave something useful - a book, a kind note or a helpful flyer.
Window-shop a street you rarely walk and pick the single most creative shop display. Photograph it and note what makes it work.
Walk to the nearest outdoor market, fruit stand or corner store and pick one seasonal fruit to try, choosing it by smell alone.
Step outside after dark and find three things that glow - a neon sign, a lit window display or the moon. Photograph your favourite.
Go for a 15-minute night walk on a well-lit route and notice how familiar places look and sound different after sunset.
Find a quiet spot outside, sit or stand comfortably and do 5 minutes of slow breathing while noticing five things you can see, hear and feel.
Take your shoes off on a safe patch of grass, sand or moss for 5 minutes, then walk slowly and notice every texture.
